```{r}
data_df$PE_scaled <- as.numeric(scale(data_df$PE))

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(data_df),
```

```{r}
modelID_begin <- 42
modelID_end <- 42
model_files <- paste0("model_ascertain_", modelID_begin:modelID_end, "_260526.stan")


for (i in 1:(modelID_end - modelID_begin + 1)) {
  # message(paste("正在运行模型:", model_files[i])) # 增加进度提示
  
  sm <- stan_model(file = file.path(stan_dir, model_files[i]))
  model_output <- tryCatch({
    sampling(
      object = sm,
      data = stan_data,
      iter = 8000,          # 进一步增加迭代次数 (原 4000)
      warmup = 4000,        # 相应增加预热期
      chains = 4,       
      cores = 4,
      seed = 123,           # 固定随机种子，方便结果复现
      # 【加这一行！】告诉 Stan 剔除掉这三个巨型/冗余变量，只保存剩下的
      # pars = c("mu", "z_int", "z_slo"), 
      # include = FALSE,     # FALSE 表示“除了上面这几个，其他的我都要”
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95,   # 默认0.8，提高到0.95-0.99
                     max_treedepth = 15)   # 默认10，提高到12或15
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("模型", model_files[i], "运行失败:", e$message))
    return(NULL) # 出错时跳过，继续下一个
  })
  
  # 保存结果（建议在循环内保存，防止断电丢失）
  if (!is.null(model_output)) {
    output_file <- paste0("model_ascertain_EXP3_", modelID_begin + i - 1,  "_output_260526.Rdata")
    save(model_output, file = file.path(result_dir, output_file))
  }

  # 1. 提取 log_likelihood
  log_lik_mat <- loo::extract_log_lik(model_output, parameter_name = "log_lik")
  
  # 2. 准备链的信息 (假设你是 4 条链)
  n_chains <- 4 
  n_iter <- nrow(log_lik_mat) / n_chains
  chain_id <- rep(1:n_chains, each = n_iter)
  r_eff <- relative_eff(exp(log_lik_mat), chain_id = chain_id)
  
  # 3. 【这行是救命的关键】必须加上 save_psis = TRUE ！！！
  loo_result <- loo(log_lik_mat, r_eff = r_eff, save_psis = TRUE)
  
  # 4. 提取后验预测值
  y_rep_samples <- rstan::extract(model_output)$y_rep
  
  # 5. 画图！直接把存下来的 psis_object 塞进去
  p <- ppc_loo_pit_overlay(
    y = data_df$alloc_var, 
    yrep = y_rep_samples, 
    psis_object = loo_result$psis_object
  )
  
  print(p)
}

```
```{r}

library(rstan)
library(loo)

model_id <- 40

load(file.path(
  result_dir,
  paste0("model_ascertain_EXP3_", model_id, "_output_260410.Rdata")
))

# 提取 log_lik
log_lik_mat <- loo::extract_log_lik(model_output, parameter_name = "log_lik")

# 计算 relative_eff
n_chains <- 4
n_iter <- nrow(log_lik_mat) / n_chains
chain_id <- rep(1:n_chains, each = n_iter)

r_eff <- loo::relative_eff(exp(log_lik_mat), chain_id = chain_id)

# 计算 LOO
loo_result <- loo::loo(log_lik_mat, r_eff = r_eff, save_psis = TRUE)

# 查看完整结果
print(loo_result)

# 提取 looic
looic <- loo_result$estimates["looic", "Estimate"]
looic_se <- loo_result$estimates["looic", "SE"]

looic
looic_se
```

## predict value predict actual value
```{r}
# 1. 计算每个观测点的预测均值 (Point Estimate)
y_rep_samples <- rstan::extract(model_output)$y_rep
y_pred <- colMeans(y_rep_samples)

# 2. 获取实际值 (对应你代码中的 data_df$alloc_var)
y_real <- data_df$alloc_var

# 3. 建立简单的回归模型 (用预测值解释实际值)
prediction_model <- lm(y_real ~ y_pred)

# 4. 报告统计值和 R 方
summary_stats <- summary(prediction_model)
print(summary_stats)

# 提取具体数值
r_squared <- summary_stats$r.squared
adj_r_squared <- summary_stats$adj.r.squared
p_value <- summary_stats$coefficients[2, 4]

message(paste("线性拟合 R2:", round(r_squared, 4)))

```

```{r}
y_rep <- rstan::extract(model_output)$y_rep
y_real <- data_df$alloc_var  # 确保你的观测值向量已经加载

# 3. 计算贝叶斯 R2 (基于方差分解公式)
# 计算预测值的方差 (每行采样计算一个方差)
var_y_rep <- apply(y_rep, 1, var)

# 计算残差的方差
res <- -1 * sweep(y_rep, 2, y_real)
var_res <- apply(res, 1, var)

# 计算贝叶斯 R2 分布
br2 <- var_y_rep / (var_y_rep + var_res)

# 4. 报告均值和分位数
print(quantile(br2, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))

```

# Parameter recovery
```{r}


# 加载必要的库
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==========================================
# 步骤 1: 构建数据生成器 (代码未变)
# ==========================================
simulate_data <- function(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 60, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平超参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # 这些值是你希望模型最终能找回来的“上帝视角”真实值
  true_params <- list(
    mu_int_neg = -0.74, sigma_int_neg = 3,
    mu_int_pos = 4.70, sigma_int_pos = 4,
    mu_slo_neg = 3.08, sigma_slo_neg = 1,
    mu_slo_pos = 3.37, sigma_slo_pos = 1,
    sigma_obs  = 2,
    nu = 4
  )
  
  # 2. 模拟个体水平参数 (使用非中心参数化逻辑)
  # 生成标准正态分布的扰动项 z
  z_int_neg <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_int_pos <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数 (严格对齐 transformed parameters 模块)
  # 截距是线性组合
  int_neg <- true_params$mu_int_neg + true_params$sigma_int_neg * z_int_neg
  int_pos <- true_params$mu_int_pos + true_params$sigma_int_pos * z_int_pos
  # 斜率带有 exp() 转换保证大于 0
  slo_neg <- true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg
  slo_pos <- true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos
  
  # 3. 生成实验设计和行为数据
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  x <- rnorm(N, 0, 1) # 生成标准化的 x 变量
  y <- numeric(N)
  
  # 逐 trial 生成数据
  for (i in 1:N) {
    s <- subject[i]
    
    # 核心分段逻辑
    if (x[i] < 0) {
      mu_gen <- int_neg[s] + slo_neg[s] * x[i]
    } else {
      mu_gen <- int_pos[s] + slo_pos[s] * x[i]
    }
    
    # 加入 Student-t 噪声
    # R 语言的 rt() 生成的是标准 t 分布，需要乘以尺度参数并加上位置参数
    y[i] <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(1, df = true_params$nu)
  }
  
  # 根据你的 Stan 代码注释，y 的范围被截断在 [-50, 50]
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # 将真实的个体参数打包，用于后续核对
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    int_neg = int_neg, int_pos = int_pos,
    slo_neg = slo_neg, slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  # 返回生成的数据和真实参数
  return(list(
    stan_data = list(N = N, S = S, subject = subject, x = x, y = y),
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind = true_ind_params
  ))
}

# ==========================================
# 步骤 2: 拟合模型与保存结果
# ==========================================
save_path <- "./04_parameter_recovery/stan_recovery_results_260621.rds" # 定义保存的文件名

if (!file.exists(save_path)) {
  message("未发现本地缓存，开始模拟数据并拟合模型...")
  
  # 生成虚拟数据
  sim_output <- simulate_data(S = 43, trials_per_subj = 60)
  
  # 调用 rstan 拟合模型
  fit_recovery <- stan(
    file = "./model_ascertain_2_260402.stan", 
    data = sim_output$stan_data,
    chains = 4, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, cores = 4, seed = 42
  )
  
  # --- 功能1：保存参数恢复的结果 ---
  # 将模拟数据和拟合结果一起打包保存
  save_results <- list(sim_output = sim_output, fit_recovery = fit_recovery)
  saveRDS(save_results, file = save_path)
  message("模型拟合完成并已保存至：", save_path)
  
} else {
  # --- 功能1：后续直接恢复结果 ---
  message("发现本地缓存，正在加载已有的拟合结果...")
  save_results <- readRDS(save_path)
  sim_output <- save_results$sim_output
  fit_recovery <- save_results$fit_recovery
}
```

```{r}
post_samples <- rstan::extract(fit_recovery)

out_dir <- "./04_parameter_recovery"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

param_palette <- c(
  "Bias_neg"  = "#4E6E9E",
  "Bias_pos"  = "#8DA6C8",
  "Slope_neg" = "#B85C5A",
  "Slope_pos" = "#D99A77"
)
param_palette <- c(
  "Bias_neg" = "#6F78B9", # 墨青
  "Bias_pos" = "#F37252", # 玫红
  "Slope_neg" = "#81D0D6", # 亮蓝
  "Slope_pos" = "#FDBC63"  # 琥珀橙
)

param_labels <- c(
  "Bias_neg"  = "Bias (x < 0)",
  "Bias_pos"  = "Bias (x >= 0)",
  "Slope_neg" = "Slope (x < 0)",
  "Slope_pos" = "Slope (x >= 0)"
)

theme_nature_recovery <- function(base_size = 26, base_family = "Arial") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.7, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2.8, "mm"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 2)),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 1, face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      # plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

save_nature_plot <- function(plot, file_stem, width_mm = 89, height_mm = 89, dpi = 600) {
  width_in <- width_mm / 25.4
  height_in <- height_mm / 25.4
  svg_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".svg"))
  pdf_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"))
  tiff_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".tiff"))
  png_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(file_stem, ".png"))

  svglite::svglite(svg_path, width = width_in, height = height_in)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(pdf_path, width = width_in, height = height_in, family = "Arial")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  ragg::agg_tiff(tiff_path, width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  ragg::agg_png(png_path, width = width_in, height = height_in, units = "in", res = 300)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}

# -------------------------
# a. Individual parameters
# -------------------------

df_ind_recovery <- tibble(
  True = c(
    sim_output$true_ind$int_neg,
    sim_output$true_ind$int_pos,
    sim_output$true_ind$slo_neg,
    sim_output$true_ind$slo_pos
  ),
  Estimated = c(
    colMeans(post_samples$int_neg),
    colMeans(post_samples$int_pos),
    colMeans(post_samples$slo_neg),
    colMeans(post_samples$slo_pos)
  ),
  Parameter = factor(
    rep(c("Bias_neg", "Bias_pos", "Slope_neg", "Slope_pos"), each = sim_output$stan_data$S),
    levels = names(param_palette)
  )
)

cor_labels <- df_ind_recovery %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(True, Estimated, method = "pearson"),
    p = cor.test(True, Estimated, method = "pearson")$p.value,
    x = max(True, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = min(Estimated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      p < 0.001,
      sprintf("italic(r)==%.2f*','~italic(p)<0.001", r),
      sprintf("italic(r)==%.2f*','~italic(p)==%.3f", r, p)
    )
  )

p_ind <- ggplot(df_ind_recovery, aes(x = True, y = Estimated, colour = Parameter)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.68, size = 4, stroke = 0) +
  geom_text(
    data = cor_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 6,
    colour = "black",
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Parameter,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 2,
    labeller = labeller(Parameter = param_labels)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = param_palette) +
  labs(x = "True parameter value", y = "Posterior mean estimate") +
  theme_nature_recovery()

print(p_ind)

save_nature_plot(
  p_ind,
  "Fig_parameter_recovery_individual_Nature",
  width_mm = 200,
  height_mm = 200,
  dpi = 600
)

# -------------------------
# b. Group-level parameters
# -------------------------

param_mapping <- c(
  "mu_int_neg" = "Bias_neg",
  "mu_int_pos" = "Bias_pos",
  "mu_slo_neg" = "Slope_neg",
  "mu_slo_pos" = "Slope_pos"
)

df_group_recovery <- bind_rows(lapply(names(param_mapping), function(param) {
  post_dist <- post_samples[[param]]
  tibble(
    Parameter = factor(param_mapping[[param]], levels = names(param_palette)),
    Estimate = post_dist,
    True = sim_output$true_hyper[[param]],
    CrI_lower = unname(quantile(post_dist, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    CrI_upper = unname(quantile(post_dist, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}))

p_group <- ggplot(df_group_recovery, aes(x = Estimate, fill = Parameter)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.55, colour = NA, adjust = 1) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = CrI_lower), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = CrI_upper), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = True), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.42) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Parameter,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 2,
    labeller = labeller(Parameter = param_labels)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = param_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.06))) +
  labs(x = "Posterior estimate", y = "Density") +
  theme_nature_recovery()

print(p_group)

save_nature_plot(
  p_group,
  "Fig_parameter_recovery_group_Nature",
  width_mm = 200,
  height_mm = 200,
  dpi = 600
)

message("Nature-style recovery figures saved to: ", normalizePath(out_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
```

```{r}


# ==========================================
# 步骤 3: 提取后验并可视化
# ==========================================
# 从模型中提取后验样本
post_samples <- rstan::extract(fit_recovery)

# --- 1. 检查个体水平参数恢复 (散点图) ---
# 提取后验均值
est_int_neg <- colMeans(post_samples$int_neg)
est_int_pos <- colMeans(post_samples$int_pos)
est_slo_neg <- colMeans(post_samples$slo_neg)
est_slo_pos <- colMeans(post_samples$slo_pos)

# 组合成数据框
df_ind_recovery <- data.frame(
  True = c(sim_output$true_ind$int_neg, sim_output$true_ind$int_pos, 
           sim_output$true_ind$slo_neg, sim_output$true_ind$slo_pos),
  Estimated = c(est_int_neg, est_int_pos, est_slo_neg, est_slo_pos),
  Parameter = factor(rep(c("Intercept (x < 0)", "Intercept (x >= 0)", 
                           "Slope (x < 0)", "Slope (x >= 0)"), 
                         each = sim_output$stan_data$S))
)

# 1. 精准修改参数名称并排序
df_ind_recovery <- df_ind_recovery %>%
  mutate(Parameter = recode(Parameter, 
    "Intercept (x < 0)"  = "Bias_neg",
    "Intercept (x >= 0)" = "Bias_pos",
    "Slope (x < 0)"      = "Slope_neg",
    "Slope (x >= 0)"     = "Slope_pos"
  )) %>%
  # 按照你要求的顺序排列：先拦截项，后斜率项
  mutate(Parameter = factor(Parameter, levels = c("Bias_neg", "Bias_pos", "Slope_neg", "Slope_pos")))

# 2. 定制“学术高定”配色方案（不发白、高级中间调）
# Intercept 用深邃的青蓝色系，Slope 用明亮的落日红橙系
academic_palette <- c(
  "Bias_neg" = "#6F78B9", # 墨青
  "Bias_pos" = "#F37252", # 玫红
  "Slope_neg"     = "#81D0D6", # 亮蓝
  "Slope_pos"     = "#FDBC63"  # 琥珀橙
)

# 3. 绘图
p_ind <- ggplot(df_ind_recovery, aes(x = True, y = Estimated, color = Parameter)) +
  # 散点：稍微调大，增加 0.7 不透明度保证色彩饱和
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 3) +
  
  # 对角线：使用浅灰色细虚线，不抢主角戏份
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # 相关性标注：使用 italic(r) 格式更显学术感
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", 
           aes(label = paste(..r.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")),
           label.x.npc = 0.01, label.y.npc = 0.97,
           size = 5.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") + 
  
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  
  # 应用新配色
  scale_color_manual(values = academic_palette) +
  
  # 主题极致润色
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    # 彻底告别默认的灰色分面标题栏
    strip.background = element_blank(), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 30),
    
    # 坐标轴与面板
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95"),
    
    axis.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 30, color = "black", face = "plain"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 30, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5)

    x = "True Parameter Value",

  )
```

```{r}

# ==========================================
# 步骤 1: 构建数据生成器
# ==========================================
simulate_data <- function(S = 40, trials_per_subj = 60, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # 1. 设定真实的群体水平超参数 (Hyperparameters)
  # 这些值是你希望模型最终能找回来的“上帝视角”真实值
  true_params <- list(
    mu_int_neg =  2.0,  sigma_int_neg = 3.0,
    mu_int_pos =  5.0,  sigma_int_pos = 4.0,
    # 注意：斜率的 mu 是在 log 尺度上的，exp(0.5) 约为 1.6
    mu_slo_neg =  5,  sigma_slo_neg = 2, 
    mu_slo_pos =  2,  sigma_slo_pos = 2,
    sigma_obs  =  8.0,  # 观测噪声
    nu         =  4.0   # Student-t 的自由度，越小尾巴越厚
  )
  
  # 2. 模拟个体水平参数 (使用非中心参数化逻辑)
  # 生成标准正态分布的扰动项 z
  z_int_neg <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_int_pos <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_slo_neg <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  z_slo_pos <- rnorm(S, 0, 1)
  
  # 转换为实际的个体参数 (严格对齐 transformed parameters 模块)
  # 截距是线性组合
  int_neg <- true_params$mu_int_neg + true_params$sigma_int_neg * z_int_neg
  int_pos <- true_params$mu_int_pos + true_params$sigma_int_pos * z_int_pos
  # 斜率带有 exp() 转换保证大于 0
  slo_neg <- true_params$mu_slo_neg + true_params$sigma_slo_neg * z_slo_neg
  slo_pos <- true_params$mu_slo_pos + true_params$sigma_slo_pos * z_slo_pos
  
  # 3. 生成实验设计和行为数据
  N <- S * trials_per_subj
  subject <- rep(1:S, each = trials_per_subj)
  x <- rnorm(N, 0, 1) # 生成标准化的 x 变量
  y <- numeric(N)
  
  # 逐 trial 生成数据
  for (i in 1:N) {
    s <- subject[i]
    
    # 核心分段逻辑
    if (x[i] < 0) {
      mu_gen <- int_neg[s] + slo_neg[s] * x[i]
    } else {
      mu_gen <- int_pos[s] + slo_pos[s] * x[i]
    }
    
    # 加入 Student-t 噪声
    # R 语言的 rt() 生成的是标准 t 分布，需要乘以尺度参数并加上位置参数
    y[i] <- mu_gen + true_params$sigma_obs * rt(1, df = true_params$nu)
  }
  
  # 根据你的 Stan 代码注释，y 的范围被截断在 [-50, 50]
  y <- pmax(pmin(y, 50), -50)
  
  # 将真实的个体参数打包，用于后续核对
  true_ind_params <- data.frame(
    subject = 1:S,
    int_neg = int_neg, int_pos = int_pos,
    slo_neg = slo_neg, slo_pos = slo_pos
  )
  
  # 返回生成的数据和真实参数
  return(list(
    stan_data = list(N = N, S = S, subject = subject, x = x, y = y),
    true_hyper = true_params,
    true_ind = true_ind_params
  ))
}

# ==========================================
# 步骤 2: 拟合模型
# ==========================================
# 生成虚拟数据 (比如 40 个人，每人 60 个 trial)
sim_output <- simulate_data(S = 40, trials_per_subj = 60)

# 调用 rstan 拟合你写好的 stan 模型 (假设文件名为 piecewise_model.stan)
fit_recovery <- stan(
  file = "model_ascertain_2_260402.stan", 
  data = sim_output$stan_data,
  chains = 4, 
  iter = 2000, 
  warmup = 1000,
  cores = 4,
  seed = 42 # 固定种子，保证结果可复现
)

# ==========================================
# 步骤 3: 提取后验并可视化
# ==========================================
# 从模型中提取后验样本
post_samples <- rstan::extract(fit_recovery)

# --- 1. 检查个体水平参数恢复 (散点图) ---
# 提取后验均值
est_int_neg <- colMeans(post_samples$int_neg)
est_int_pos <- colMeans(post_samples$int_pos)
est_slo_neg <- colMeans(post_samples$slo_neg)
est_slo_pos <- colMeans(post_samples$slo_pos)

# 组合成数据框
df_ind_recovery <- data.frame(
  True = c(sim_output$true_ind$int_neg, sim_output$true_ind$int_pos, 
           sim_output$true_ind$slo_neg, sim_output$true_ind$slo_pos),
  Estimated = c(est_int_neg, est_int_pos, est_slo_neg, est_slo_pos),
  Parameter = factor(rep(c("Intercept (x < 0)", "Intercept (x >= 0)", 
                           "Slope (x < 0)", "Slope (x >= 0)"), 
                         each = sim_output$stan_data$S))
)

# 画个体水平散点图
p_ind <- ggplot(df_ind_recovery, aes(x = True, y = Estimated, color = Parameter)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Individual-level Parameter Recovery",
       x = "True Generated Value", y = "Estimated Posterior Mean") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_ind)

# --- 2. 检查群体水平参数恢复 (后验分布图) ---
# 检查这四个核心群体均值
hyper_params_to_check <- c("mu_int_neg", "mu_int_pos", "mu_slo_neg", "mu_slo_pos")

plot_list <- list()
for (param in hyper_params_to_check) {
  
  # 提取真实值和后验分布
  true_val <- sim_output$true_hyper[[param]]
  post_dist <- post_samples[[param]]
  
  # 计算 95% 贝叶斯置信区间 (HDI)
  hdi_lower <- quantile(post_dist, 0.025)
  hdi_upper <- quantile(post_dist, 0.975)
  
  # 画密度图
  plot_list[[param]] <- ggplot(data.frame(x = post_dist), aes(x = x)) +
    geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = true_val, color = "red", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(hdi_lower, hdi_upper), color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = param, x = "Posterior Estimate", y = "Density") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# 拼图并展示群体参数恢复
p_group <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Group-level Hyperparameter Recovery",
                  subtitle = "Red line = True Value, Dashed lines = 95% CrI")
print(p_group)


```
